what_this_is: W21 furigana residue (C13): the `reading` attribute on the lesson-body <jp> spans scripts/build_furigana_table.py refused. Adds an attribute only.
fold_rule: verdict keyed by the row's stable identity: ok -> the authored text; corrected -> the verifier's text (authored text kept as authored_*); rejected -> `held`, never applied
apply_contract: per lesson, in table order, per span: body.count(from) == count, then body = body.replace(from, to). A span whose `from` is gone (and whose `to` is present, when non-empty) is already applied. Both layers: research/derived/lessons/<slug>.json body and localized_text(lesson, body, pt-BR).

authored_header.generated_by: scratchpad pauth/furigana_residue/build.py (authoring pass over the W21 residue)
authored_header.method: Input: research/derived/repairs/lesson_furigana.json `residue` (W21, keyed by lesson+surface), lesson text read from git HEAD. (1) MECHANICAL: a span that is a radical/component character (亻 氵 宀 ...) takes kanjialive `rad_name_ja` for its radical form (supplement/Kangxi/positional-PUA character mapped explicitly); a lone kanji the prose prints as a component of another kanji takes the kanjialive name for the matching position (言 left = ごんべん, 日 left = ひへん, 金 left = かねへん, 食 left = しょくへん, else the standalone radical name). (2) CONTEXT: every other span takes the reading its own lesson fixes: kana printed beside it, a sibling span already carrying the reading, the gloss, the lesson title, the bank kana of the sentence it explains, or (kanji-exame checklists) the reading the lesson's own exercises drill, stem form like the sibling checks. Digits are spelled in kana because READING_OK excludes them. (3) Rows the context cannot settle to ONE reading per (lesson, surface) stay in `undecided` with the reason. Radical names cannot align against the Layer-A kanji registry (the characters are not in it) and 明日/風邪/下手 are 熟字訓 that kanji_align refuses: the apply needs a kanjialive-source and a whole-word allowance for those rows rather than silently skipping them. Layer C, needs_review: true; pending, not applied.

verdict_summary.note: One decided row is wrong: 夂 under 夏 is なつあし, not のまた. Eight of the nine undecided rows are settled here; two of them (何 in n4-condicionais-08, 人 in n5-numeros-tempo-02) need a reading per occurrence, so `corrected` is a list in document order and the apply must key them by occurrence. 来 in n5-verbos-03 is rejected: it should be exempt from furigana. Confirmed by data: kanji-exame readings match the lessons' exercises (乗 の, 低 ひく, 働 はたら, 合 あい, 太 ふと, 好 す, 引 ひ, 暗 くら, 民 みん, 産 さん, 短 みじか, 軽 かる, 進 すす, 門 もん, 古 ふる, 多 おお, 安 やす, 社 しゃ, 立 た, 言 い, 買 か, 飲 の); bank kana confirm 開きそうにない/開く ひらく, 一千万円 いっせんまんえん, 一年前くらい前に, 来たことがあるの きた; kanjialive confirms 巾 はば (市) and かねへん (銀). READING_OK accepts the space, 〜 and ？ carried by 各 の 駅, 〜の中で and 明日の予定は？.

rows.evidence: Undecided row (no reading). 也 is printed as the right component of 他 with no gloss; its only modern reading is the on'yomi や (なり is classical), and nothing in the lesson points elsewhere.

Undecided row (no reading). The prose glosses the pair as 'até o mestre corre', so this 走 is the 'correr' of 走る (N5 vocab, はしる); the course writes a lone verb kanji with its stem (暑 あつ, 売 う, 使 つか). そう carries no 'correr' word the learner knows, and わす belongs only to the whole 師走.

Undecided row: the two occurrences need different readings, so one (lesson, surface) reading cannot be right. In document order: '何を食べるか決めていない ... (何 = o quê)' is なに; 'Molde: 何 [contador] か' is なん (the same passage prints 何[なん] and 何人[なんにん]). `corrected` lists them per occurrence; the apply must key this row by occurrence, not by surface.

Undecided row; the builder's refusal is refuted. 'o radical de 老 em cima' names radical 125 (老, top form 耂), which kanjialive gives as 考's radical ⺹ おいかんむり, position かんむり. Printing the full form and reading it with the positional radical name is exactly what this same table does for 言→ごんべん, 金→かねへん, 食→しょくへん, so no prose change is needed.
Undecided row (no reading). No exercise drills 寒, so take the sibling-check convention (the reading of the kanji's basic word, stem form: 暑 あつ, 太 ふと): 寒い さむい is N5 vocab in the registry.
Undecided row (no reading). No exercise drills 洗; sibling-check convention gives the stem of its basic word 洗う あらう (N5 vocab in the registry; n3-relato-04 prints 洗う[あらう] for the same kanji).
Undecided row (no reading). No exercise drills 菜; its basic word for this level is 野菜 やさい (N5 vocab in the registry), so the kanji's reading there is さい. な (菜の花) is not in the learner's vocabulary.

Undecided row: the two occurrences need different readings. The bank sentence sent:tatoeba-141433 is 千人くらいの人がいた (kana せんにんくらいのひとがいた).
